label: Phase two — the realization

recentEvents.value: He read the stranger the names of the chambers he stood on; the stranger heard every word and answered with his blade.
The genealogies have stopped. The pauses grow longer.

unresolvedConflicts.value: It is not ignorance in the intruder. It is choice.

temporaryObjective.value: Stop lecturing and start interposing himself between the intruder and the chambers.

notes: The suspicion in his profile's suspects bucket is confirmed here: 'You understand every word I say, don't you? Then it is not ignorance in you. It is choice.'
